title: Wake / route / watcher (level a, fake forge): issue -> head -> CI -> verdict -> merge; replayed and reordered events; watcher restarted between stages; idle backoff; missed-event reconcile and interrupted-route retry

steps.name: up-and-baseline
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; mkdir -p $G && echo [] > $G/pr-list.json && echo [] > $G/issue-list.json && echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json && $C up $P && $C poll --once $P | grep -q "baseline of 0 PRs, 0 issues"

steps.name: idle-backoff-no-model-turns
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; for i in 1 2 3; do t0=$(date +%s); $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 1 --idle 0 $P | grep -q "backstop: due (nothing in flight)" || exit 1; echo "wake $i after $(( $(date +%s)-t0 ))s idle=$(python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))['idle'])" $S/wake/watch-state.json)"; done > {state_dir}/a04-wakes.txt; cat {state_dir}/a04-wakes.txt >&2; grep -q "wake 3 .* idle=3$" {state_dir}/a04-wakes.txt && test "$(grep -c "^got ash: " {state_dir}/stub.log)" -eq 3 && grep -c "^got ash: wake: watcher$" {state_dir}/stub.log | grep -qx 3

steps.name: issue-assigned-once-under-replay
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; rm -f $S/wake/queue.jsonl; echo '[{"number":2,"labels":[{"name":"crew:ready"}],"assignees":[{"login":"sandbox-builder"}],"body":""}]' > $G/issue-list.json; for i in 1 2 3; do $C poll --once $P; done; test "$(n issue-assigned)" -eq 1

steps.name: issue-routes-to-builder-lead-once
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; cat $S/wake/queue.jsonl $S/wake/queue.jsonl > $S/q && mv $S/q $S/wake/queue.jsonl && $C route $P && test ! -s $S/wake/queue.jsonl && test "$(grep -c "\"kind\": \"work\"" $S/inbox/builder-lead.jsonl)" -eq 1 && grep -l "\"issue-assigned\"" $S/leads/builder-events/*.json | grep -c . | grep -qx 1

steps.name: new-head-reordered-replay-one-review-handoff
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; pr() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,h,ci,rv,st,g=sys.argv[1:]; ci,rv=json.loads(ci),json.loads(rv); lab=[{\"name\":\"crew:in-review\"}]; json.dump([dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,labels=lab,statusCheckRollup=ci,reviews=rv)] if st==\"OPEN\" else [],open(g+\"/pr-list.json\",\"w\")); json.dump(dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=lab,reviews=rv,statusCheckRollup=ci,headRefName=\"builder/2-x\",baseRefName=\"main\",headRepositoryOwner=dict(login=\"campaign\"),headRepository=dict(name=\"sandbox-{run_id}\"),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)]),open(g+\"/pr-view-\"+n+\".json\",\"w\"))" "$@" $G; }; h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pull/5/head); GREEN='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"COMPLETED","conclusion":"SUCCESS","name":"ci"}]'; PASS="[{\"body\":\"<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=5 sha=$h round=1 verdict=pass -->\"}]"; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; cd {state_dir}/../repo && git checkout -q -b b5 && echo x > f.txt && git add f.txt && git -c user.name=c -c user.email=c@x commit -qm "feat: x" -m "Engine: claude-code opus medium" && git push -q origin HEAD:refs/pull/5/head HEAD:refs/heads/builder/2-x && git checkout -q main && cd - >/dev/null && h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse refs/pull/5/head) && pr 5 $h "[]" "[]" OPEN && $C poll --once $P && $C poll --once $P; test "$(n new-head)" -eq 1 || exit 1; echo '{"event":"builder-queued","reason":"spawn"}' >> $S/wake/queue.jsonl; tac $S/wake/queue.jsonl > $S/q 2>/dev/null || tail -r $S/wake/queue.jsonl > $S/q; cat $S/q $S/wake/queue.jsonl > $S/q2 && mv $S/q2 $S/wake/queue.jsonl && rm $S/q; $C route $P; test "$(grep -c "\"kind\": \"work\"" $S/inbox/reviewer-lead.jsonl)" -eq 1 && grep -l "$h" $S/leads/reviewer-events/*.json | grep -c . | grep -qx 1

steps.name: ci-passed-judgement-survives-watcher-restarts
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; pr() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,h,ci,rv,st,g=sys.argv[1:]; ci,rv=json.loads(ci),json.loads(rv); lab=[{\"name\":\"crew:in-review\"}]; json.dump([dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,labels=lab,statusCheckRollup=ci,reviews=rv)] if st==\"OPEN\" else [],open(g+\"/pr-list.json\",\"w\")); json.dump(dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=lab,reviews=rv,statusCheckRollup=ci,headRefName=\"builder/2-x\",baseRefName=\"main\",headRepositoryOwner=dict(login=\"campaign\"),headRepository=dict(name=\"sandbox-{run_id}\"),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)]),open(g+\"/pr-view-\"+n+\".json\",\"w\"))" "$@" $G; }; h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pull/5/head); GREEN='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"COMPLETED","conclusion":"SUCCESS","name":"ci"}]'; PASS="[{\"body\":\"<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=5 sha=$h round=1 verdict=pass -->\"}]"; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; rm -f $S/wake/queue.jsonl; pr 5 $h "$GREEN" "[]" OPEN; $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 20 --no-nudge $P | grep -q "poll: ci-passed" || exit 1; for i in 1 2; do $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 1 --no-nudge $P | grep -q "backstop: due (work in flight)" || exit 1; done; $C route $P; test "$(n ci-passed)" -eq 1

steps.name: verdict-pass-to-synthesizer-once
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; pr() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,h,ci,rv,st,g=sys.argv[1:]; ci,rv=json.loads(ci),json.loads(rv); lab=[{\"name\":\"crew:in-review\"}]; json.dump([dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,labels=lab,statusCheckRollup=ci,reviews=rv)] if st==\"OPEN\" else [],open(g+\"/pr-list.json\",\"w\")); json.dump(dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=lab,reviews=rv,statusCheckRollup=ci,headRefName=\"builder/2-x\",baseRefName=\"main\",headRepositoryOwner=dict(login=\"campaign\"),headRepository=dict(name=\"sandbox-{run_id}\"),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)]),open(g+\"/pr-view-\"+n+\".json\",\"w\"))" "$@" $G; }; h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pull/5/head); GREEN='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"COMPLETED","conclusion":"SUCCESS","name":"ci"}]'; PASS="[{\"body\":\"<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=5 sha=$h round=1 verdict=pass -->\"}]"; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; pr 5 $h "$GREEN" "$PASS" OPEN; $C poll --once $P && $C poll --once $P && $C route $P; test "$(n review-approved)" -eq 1 && grep "review-approved" $S/wake/queue.jsonl | grep -q "\"consumer\": \"synthesizer\""

steps.name: merge-missed-while-watcher-down-reconciled
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; pr() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,h,ci,rv,st,g=sys.argv[1:]; ci,rv=json.loads(ci),json.loads(rv); lab=[{\"name\":\"crew:in-review\"}]; json.dump([dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,labels=lab,statusCheckRollup=ci,reviews=rv)] if st==\"OPEN\" else [],open(g+\"/pr-list.json\",\"w\")); json.dump(dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=lab,reviews=rv,statusCheckRollup=ci,headRefName=\"builder/2-x\",baseRefName=\"main\",headRepositoryOwner=dict(login=\"campaign\"),headRepository=dict(name=\"sandbox-{run_id}\"),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)]),open(g+\"/pr-view-\"+n+\".json\",\"w\"))" "$@" $G; }; h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pull/5/head); GREEN='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"COMPLETED","conclusion":"SUCCESS","name":"ci"}]'; PASS="[{\"body\":\"<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=5 sha=$h round=1 verdict=pass -->\"}]"; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; rm -f $S/wake/queue.jsonl; pr 5 $h "$GREEN" "$PASS" MERGED; $C watch --source "$C poll --once $P" --interval 0.5 --backstop 2 --no-nudge $P | grep -q "backstop: due" || exit 1; test "$(n pr-merged)" -eq 0 && grep -c "^api -X DELETE repos/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/git/refs/heads/builder/2-x$" {state_dir}/gh.log | grep -qx 1

steps.name: interrupted-route-batch-retried
steps.run: C="python3 {source}/cli/mdstack"; P="--project $CREW_PROJECT"; S={state_dir}/campaign__sandbox-{run_id}; T=crew-campaign-{run_id}; G={state_dir}/gh; pr() { python3 -c "import json,sys; n,h,ci,rv,st,g=sys.argv[1:]; ci,rv=json.loads(ci),json.loads(rv); lab=[{\"name\":\"crew:in-review\"}]; json.dump([dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,labels=lab,statusCheckRollup=ci,reviews=rv)] if st==\"OPEN\" else [],open(g+\"/pr-list.json\",\"w\")); json.dump(dict(number=int(n),state=st,headRefOid=h,isDraft=False,labels=lab,reviews=rv,statusCheckRollup=ci,headRefName=\"builder/2-x\",baseRefName=\"main\",headRepositoryOwner=dict(login=\"campaign\"),headRepository=dict(name=\"sandbox-{run_id}\"),isCrossRepository=False,closingIssuesReferences=[dict(number=2)]),open(g+\"/pr-view-\"+n+\".json\",\"w\"))" "$@" $G; }; h=$(git -C {state_dir}/../origin.git rev-parse -q --verify refs/pull/5/head); GREEN='[{"__typename":"CheckRun","status":"COMPLETED","conclusion":"SUCCESS","name":"ci"}]'; PASS="[{\"body\":\"<!-- crew:v1 role=reviewer-validator pass=verdict pr=5 sha=$h round=1 verdict=pass -->\"}]"; n() { grep -c "\"event\": \"$1\"" $S/wake/queue.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true; }; rm -f $G/repo-view.json; printf "%s\n" "{\"id\":\"replay-merged\",\"source\":\"poll\",\"reason\":\"poll\",\"event\":\"pr-merged\",\"consumer\":\"coordinator\",\"refs\":[\"#5\",\"$h\"]}" >> $S/wake/queue.jsonl; $C route $P 2>/dev/null; ls $S/wake/queue.jsonl.route-* >/dev/null || exit 1; echo '{"defaultBranchRef":{"name":"main"}}' > $G/repo-view.json; $C route $P && ! ls $S/wake/queue.jsonl.route-* 2>/dev/null && test "$(n pr-merged)" -eq 0 && grep -c "^api -X DELETE repos/campaign/sandbox-{run_id}/git/refs/heads/builder/2-x$" {state_dir}/gh.log | grep -qx 2
